rules.description: Forward-return horizons in ms.
evidence: CP24/CP36 block-level CSV `horizon_ms` distinct values = {100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,30000}
Handoff §12 states the eight horizons explicitly

rules.description: Quantile levels evaluated per feature.
evidence: CP24/CP36 block-level CSV `q` distinct values = {0.8,0.9,0.95}
Reports state q90 is the primary decision quantile

rules.description: Evaluation block = (session_id, asset).
evidence: CP24 has 14 (session,asset) blocks, CP36 all36 has 22 = 14+8
Every block-level CSV keys on session+asset

rules.description: Row admissible for analysis iff adjusted_fair_venue_count>=2 AND bitget_book_age_recv_ms<=1000 AND bitget_mid finite and positive.
evidence: Handoff §12 states the quality gate
Collector exposes adjusted_fair_venue_count, book_age_recv_ms, mid

rules.description: Target = Bitget mid forward log-return * 10000 (bps).
evidence: Handoff §12 target
Collector uses log(x2/x1)*10000 for every bps quantity

rules.description: 12 simple analysis features (bitget_ofi, bitget_trade_flow, depth_imbalance_l1/l5, external_ofi, external_trade_flow, fair_accel_100ms, fair_gap_reversion, leader_gap_{100,200,500,1000}ms).
evidence: CP24 simple block-level CSV distinct `feature` values

rules.description: Composite features are evaluated at 5 horizons only: {1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 30000} ms. Sub-second horizons {100, 200, 500} are NOT evaluated on any composite.
evidence: CP24 composite block-level CSV `horizon_ms` distinct values = {1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 30000}
CP36 composite_block_level_new12 same subset

rules.description: 10 composite features (depthBoth, depthL1_extOFI, gap_depthBoth, gap_depthL1, gap_depth_extOFI, gap_extOFI, gap_leader1000, gap_localOFI, gap_localTrade, leader1000_extOFI).
evidence: CP24 composite block-level CSV distinct `feature` values

rules.description: Mapping from analysis feature names to collector grid columns (bitget_ofi -> bitget_ofi_norm_l1, depth_imbalance_l1 -> bitget_depth_imbalance_l1, fair_gap_reversion -> bitget_gap_to_fair_bps, leader_gap_{X}ms -> leader_gap_{X}ms_bps, etc.).
evidence: Feature names + collector output field names are mutually suggestive; final confirmation requires reproducing block N and mean_signed_bps against a raw OLD36 grid.

rules.description: Direction: +sign(signal) for every simple feature, except fair_gap_reversion which uses -sign(gap).
evidence: Handoff §12 direction rules

rules.description: Forward return at horizon H is mid[t+H]/mid[t] on the 100ms grid.
evidence: Grid is a 100ms monotonic sampler; log/bps convention explicit
Exact end-of-session truncation (censor last H rows vs. drop) not specified anywhere in the artifacts
rules.inferred_hypothesis: Drop rows where t+H exceeds grid end; drop rows where either mid is not finite/positive.

rules.description: Event = row where |signal| >= q_q(|signal|) computed on the quality-filtered block (session,asset).
evidence: All 24H threshold values observed in CSV are positive, consistent with quantiles of |signal| on symmetric signed signals
Report describes q80/q90/q95 tail selection
rules.inferred_hypothesis: threshold = numpy.quantile(|signal|, q); event iff |signal| >= threshold.

rules.description: Minimum spacing between accepted events = max(1s, horizon).
evidence: Handoff §12 states the spacing rule

rules.description: Algorithm to pick which of two overlapping candidates to keep.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: greedy earliest-first pass along the grid.

rules.description: How exact-quantile-boundary values are counted (>= vs >).
How NaN forward returns / NaN signals are handled.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: drop rows with NaN signal or NaN forward mid.

rules.description: Policy for the tail max_horizon of each session/asset.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: drop rows where t+H > session end for each horizon independently.

rules.description: Block counts as positive iff mean_signed_bps > 0.
evidence: Aggregates CSVs report positive_blocks; block-level CSVs allow verifying that this is the count of blocks where mean_signed_bps > 0

rules.description: Formula and normalization of the depthBoth composite.
evidence: CP24 threshold values for depthBoth differ from either component; consistent with a derived-signal quantile (e.g. mean of two normalized components) but multiple normalizations satisfy this.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: depthBoth = (rank(depth_imbalance_l1) + rank(depth_imbalance_l5)) / 2, then threshold on |depthBoth|. Not selected without golden regression.

rules.description: Formula of every gap_* composite (localTrade, extOFI, depth_extOFI, depthL1, depthBoth, leader1000, localOFI).
evidence: CP24 CSV thresholds for every gap_* composite match the fair_gap_reversion threshold exactly for the same block/horizon/q. This proves the gap_* composites gate on the fair-gap quantile. The auxiliary condition (sign agreement vs magnitude threshold on the second component) is not determined by the artifacts.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: Event iff fair-gap quantile crossed AND sign of second component agrees with -sign(gap).

rules.description: Formula of the leader1000_extOFI composite.
evidence: CP24 CSV thresholds match leader_gap_1000ms threshold exactly; composite gates on leader1000 quantile. Combination with extOFI remains underspecified by artifacts.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: Event iff leader1000 quantile crossed AND sign(extOFI) agrees with sign(leader_gap).

rules.description: Component weights inside every composite.
evidence: No weights file present in either checkpoint ZIP

rules.description: Per-component normalization used before composite formation.
Definition of the alignment filter used inside gap_* composites.
evidence: Collector exposes bitget_fair_ofi_alignment and bitget_fair_trade_alignment (both = sign(-gap)*sign(local_signal)). Whether composites use these binary flags or thresholded magnitudes is not stated.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: Use the collector-provided alignment binary; require ==+1.

rules.description: How per-block mean_signed_bps aggregate up to feature-level headline numbers.
evidence: Aggregate mean_signed_bps in simple_aggregates_24h.csv equals the pooled mean if reproduced from per-event returns, or the unweighted mean of per-block means. Which one applies is decidable once the raw grids are available.

rules.description: BTC/ETH block combination inside feature-level aggregates.
evidence: Aggregate row count `blocks` includes both BTC and ETH; BTC and ETH appear as independent (session,asset) blocks.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: BTC and ETH are treated as independent blocks; no cross-asset weighting.

rules.description: Boundaries used to bucket rows into low/mid/high external dispersion tertiles.
evidence: Per-block disp_lo and disp_hi columns are exposed in fair-gap dispersion CSVs; whether they are computed on the quality-filtered grid, event-only rows, or across the whole session is not stated.
rules.inferred_hypothesis: per-block tertiles of external_perp_dispersion_bps on the quality-filtered grid rows.

rules.description: Standalone directional promotion hurdle = 15 bps.
evidence: Handoff §12; both CP24 and CP36 reports

rules.description: 100ms–5s = execution-timing; 10s–30s = markout/adverse-selection.
evidence: CP24 and CP36 reports state this split verbatim
